title: "The World is a Corporation" (Network, 1976)
summary: A six-minute clip of the famous speech from the 1976 film Network in which the world is described as a corporation. It portrays a world run by corporate interests.
why: HN posts it as an enduring, still-relevant artistic depiction of corporate power when discussing finance, tech lobbying and ethics.

quote.text: For an artistic, but accurate image of the world we live in see this scene from Network (1976)
